title: Outlook Dropdown Email Template Builder
description: A reusable digital product that allows users to create customizable email templates with dropdown lists for efficient communication.
audience: Outlook users who need to send out standardized emails with predefined options for faster and more accurate data entry.
pitch: This product enables users to create email templates with dropdown lists, allowing them to select from predefined options and streamline their communication process.

market_validation.reason: Low-cost original pilot answering a real first-person user problem, with market validation still to be measured. No verified demand or revenue is claimed.

What about selecting multiple items? And is it possible to populate a dropdown from a database? You will find all the answers in this tutorial. Email templates are a great way to save time on routine correspondence. But very often, you still have to manually input some variables when preparing an email to send out. In case you are entering unique data in every message, the optimal solution would be an email template with fillable text fields . When choosing from a predefined set of values, nothing beats a dropdown menu. Regrettably, there is no easy way to make a dropdown in an Outlook template. Perhaps, you could approach the task by creating a custom form, placing a ComboBox control onto it, and somehow plugging a selected value into a message.
